facts.fact: 她的开场：恐惧有气味，暴怒也有——两样都不缺。
facts.anchor: Fear had a scent. So did fury.

facts.fact: 她的评估：这些不是喝下午茶的弱女人，是 Alphas、CEO、政客。
facts.anchor: These weren't helpless women gathered for tea.

facts.fact: Nell 的法律反击：你们闯进的是仅限受邀的私人聚会。
facts.anchor: "You've entered a private party during an invitation-only gathering,"
Money laundering. Conspiracy to commit money laundering.

facts.fact: 她的判读：这不是逮捕，是羞辱——打 Mei Ling 的名誉。
facts.anchor: This wasn't an arrest. It was humiliation.

facts.fact: Sorsha 的破绽：全场心跳都变，只有她的没变。
母亲的耳语：别怕，妈妈抱住你了。
facts.anchor: "Don't look so frightened, darling. Mommy's got you."

facts.fact: 二选一：闭嘴，或者说实话。
facts.anchor: "You can keep quiet. Or you can tell them the truth."

facts.fact: 她的死局：两样不能都要。
facts.anchor: "But you don't get to do both."

facts.fact: 章末：母亲学会了她的游戏，并且赢了她。
facts.anchor: My mother had learned my game. And she'd just beaten me at it.
